target: higher order inflorescence axis (PO_0009081)
reason: Narrower. In Cyperaceae (Carex, Schoenus, Lagenocarpus, Rhynchospora) a partial panicle is a branch of the whole panicle together with its spikelets, i.e. a paraclade; 'paraclade' and 'inflorescence branch' are PO synonyms of PO_0009081. It is used for counts ('3-6 partial panicles') and for 'further branched'. Not the first order axis, because the partial panicles are the lateral branches.

label: rachilla extension
parent: is_a PO_0025029 (shoot axis); part_of PO_0009080 (spikelet rachilla)
definition: A shoot axis (PO:0025029) that is the distal portion of a spikelet rachilla (PO:0009080) prolonged beyond the insertion of the uppermost floret, often bristle-like, sometimes bearing a rudimentary floret. NOTE: No such class in PO. Its presence or absence and its length are standard diagnostic characters in grasses (e.g. Calamagrostis, Colpodium).
reason: A real structure that grass floras describe often (present/absent, length, hairy). It cannot be expressed as the apex of the rachilla because floras state that it is absent. Propose it to PO upstream next to spikelet rachilla. Note Marco Schmidt's concern about grass-only PO terms: this one is a general Poaceae character, not a maize term.

target: connective appendage (FLOPO_0986073)
reason: Exact: the FLOPO class already exists. The connective belongs to the anther, so the 'anther' prefix adds nothing.

A generic part that needs its organ. The data mixes Bazzania underleaves and bracts (liverwort) with a Diplazium leaf, and 'lateral margins' of the lip, galea and hood elsewhere. 'margin' and 'lateral lobe' were rejected on 2026-11-13. Where the organ is named, its margin class (e.g. leaf lamina margin PO_0025009) takes the statement.

target: plant organ apex (FLOPO_0985023) part of megasporophyll (PO_0009027)
reason: Conifer seed scales (Larix, Abies, Picea, Pseudotsuga) are ovuliferous scales; 'ovuliferous scale' and 'cone scale' are PO synonyms of megasporophyll PO_0009027. The apex is a region, expressed as the organ apex of that whole. 'seed scale' alone should get a bearer rule to PO_0009027, and 'seed scale base' should go to plant organ base (FLOPO_0985024) in the same way.

Homonym. In these records (Lygodium) it is the narrow fertile lobe of a pinnule that bears the sporangia ('narrow part (sorophore)', 2-12 mm). In Marsilea, 'sorophore' is the gelatinous ring that carries the sori out of the sporocarp. It is limited to one genus, and the word alone cannot tell the senses apart.

target: spadix appendix (FLOPO_0986049)
reason: Exact: an Araceae term (whip-like, stout, 15-22 cm), the same as the existing FLOPO class spadix appendix.

target: pattern 10, ratio to another part, with calyx (PO_0009060) as the reference
reason: A fragment of a ratio ('2-3 times the length of the calyx'). 'times calyx' and 'calyx length' were rejected the same way. The bearer is the part named before it (the pedicel).

target: portion of secretory tissue (PO_0005656) part of leaf lamina (PO_0020039), pattern 12
reason: Glands on the leaf blade of Adenia and Passiflora, counted (0-8), absent or measured. 'gland' already maps to PO_0005656 (rule C265); 'laminal' gives the whole they belong to.

target: raceme inflorescence (PO_0030115) with position lateral (FLOPO_0991380), pattern 18
reason: A raceme in lateral position, as 'lateral umbels' in pattern 18. Counts, length, spreading and density all fit. If it is used often, it can become a named positioned part.

target: secondary leaf vein (PO_0020140)
reason: Narrower, the same as 'primary lateral vein' in rule C275: the main lateral veins of the blade, counted per side. The positioned part 'lateral vascular bundle' (FLOPO_0996001) also has 'lateral vein' as a synonym. The two rules should agree.

target: trichome (PO_0000282) part of floret callus (FLOPO_0986120), pattern 12
reason: In grasses, the hairs on the floret callus (2-3 mm long, abundant or scanty, as long as the lemma). Both classes exist; the hairs are parts of the callus.

A generic part that needs its organ. Here it is a short basal tube of the anther that holds the filament ('dorsifixed in short sleeve of anther'), but elsewhere it can be a sheath of any organ. Like 'sheath' and 'tube', which were rejected on 2026-11-13.

target: corolla lobe (FLOPO_0986006); the number of segments is a count of parts (pattern 03) on the corolla lobe
reason: Only in Sapotaceae (Mimusops, Manilkara), where each corolla lobe is divided into a median segment and two lateral dorsal appendages. Too narrow for a new class; 'segment' was rejected as generic. The count goes on corolla lobe. The qualities of the segments (keeled, clawed) attach to corolla lobe and lose some detail.

Two unrelated senses. In Cycas, 'spongy layer absent' is a layer of the seed coat; in Barbacenia, 'translucent cells in spongy layer' is leaf mesophyll (spongy mesophyll PO_0005647). The word alone cannot tell them apart.

A generic pit that needs its organ: nectariferous pits on Frasera corolla lobes in one source, and other pitted surfaces ('marked with 22-26 foveae', Scabiosa) in others. 'pit' and 'pore' were rejected on 2026-11-13.

The degree of division of the leaf blade in Corydalis and Dicentra ('blade with 2-4 orders of leaflets and lobes'). It is a quality of the leaf lamina, not a structure. 'order' and 'level' were rejected the same way.

target: pattern 14, count at a position: leaf lamina lobe (PO_0025517) counted on each side
reason: A count phrase. 'per side' and 'each side' were rejected before; the counted part is the lobe of the organ being described.

target: scale leaf (PO_0006003) on the peduncle (PO_0009053; 'scape' maps there by rule C255), pattern 12
reason: In Eriocaulon, the tubular sheath round the base of the scape; in Eulophia and Renealmia, the sterile sheathing cataphylls on the scape. Both are sheathing scale leaves (cataphyll maps to scale leaf by rule C263) on the scape. It has length, width, colour, tubular and inflated.

target: pattern 03, count of parts, with pinna (FLOPO_0985027) in state fertile (pattern 04) as the whole
reason: The unit of a count of sori in Polystichum ('4-8 per fertile pinna'). 'per pinna' was rejected the same way. The bearer is the counted sorus.

target: pattern 10, ratio to another part, with tepal (PO_0009033) as the reference
reason: The second term of a length ratio ('filaments 2/3 as long as perianth segments'), like 'calyx length' and 'times calyx'. The bearer is the filament.

target: bract (PO_0009055)
reason: Narrower: in bamboos (Bambusa, Melocalamus), the bracts at the base of a pseudospikelet that bear axillary buds. They are bracts, and their only character here is a count. 'Gemmiferous' is a state of the bract, not a separate structure.

target: pattern 14, count at a position: sori counted on the acroscopic side of the pinna (FLOPO_0985027)
reason: A position fragment of a count ('sori 15 on acroscopic side of pinna'), like 'on each side'. The counted part, the sorus (PO_0025359), is the bearer.

target: vitta (FLOPO_0986042)
reason: Exact: a cut-off form of 'vittae' in Apiaceae fruits (Ferula, Bupleurum, Arracacia: '4-5 in each furrow', '10-12 on commissure'). The vitta class exists. Better to fix the word splitter so that 'vittae' and Spanish 'vitas' reach the existing class; map 'vit' only if the fragment cannot be avoided.

target: seed chalaza (PO_0006333)
reason: Narrower: in Vitaceae seeds (Ampelopsis, Vitis), the chalazal knot is the visible chalaza on the dorsal face of the seed. Its shape (elliptic, ovate-elliptic) is the character.

label: false indusium
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of PO_0009025 (vascular leaf)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of a vascular leaf (PO:0009025) that is a reflexed, often thinner and modified portion of the leaf lamina margin covering the sori (PO:0025359), as in many Pteridaceae. NOTE: Sibling of indusium (FLOPO:0986020), which grows from the lamina surface or receptacle. PO has neither.
reason: A standard fern structure (Adiantum, Cheilanthes, Pteris, Cheilanthopsis) that differs from a true indusium. Floras describe it as present/absent, small, membranous or fimbriate. Propose it to PO upstream together with indusium.

target: trichome cell (PO_0008030)
reason: Exact in these records: the cells of a multicellular hair (Hypolepis, Polypodium, Solanum). Counts such as '3-7-celled' are pattern 03, with trichome (PO_0000282) as the whole and trichome cell as the part. Warning: PO lists 'hair cell' as a synonym of trichoblast (PO_0000262), a root epidermal cell; that sense must not be used here.

target: compound raceme inflorescence (PO_0030116)
reason: Narrower: in Salvia, a panicle whose branches are racemes, i.e. a first order axis carrying racemose higher order axes, which matches PO's compound raceme. The only statement is 'present', i.e. the inflorescence type.

target: pattern 03, count of parts: flowers (PO_0009046) counted per fascicle
reason: A count phrase ('flowers 3-7-fascicled'), like 'per cluster' and 'per whorl', which were rejected before. The flower is the counted part.

target: shoot axis apex (PO_0000037) part of rhizome (PO_0004542)
reason: In ferns, the growing tip of the rhizome, densely scaly or pubescent. A rhizome is a shoot axis, and PO's shoot axis apex is the distal part of a shoot axis, so the region pattern applies.
